9441169c7ca5b6b95c0e47973f605cb85c0f7400.sourceText:
| 参数名 | 当前值 | 单位 | 实车处理建议 | 作用 | 调大效果 | 调小效果 | 生效条件／备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path_en` | `False` | 不适用，布尔 | **根据实际功能需求开启或设置** | 是否发布累计运行轨迹 | 不适用 | 不适用 | True 发布 path，坐标系为 camera_init；轨迹持续累计 |
| `scan_publish_en` | `True` | 不适用，布尔 | **通常保持当前值，不作为优先调试项** | 是否发布参考系中的配准扫描点云 | 不适用 | 不适用 | 发布 cloud_registered，坐标系为 camera_init；本地 PCD 点云累计也依赖此开关 |
| `scan_bodyframe_pub_en` | `False` | 不适用，布尔 | **根据实际功能需求开启或设置** | 是否额外发布内部 IMU 坐标系中的点云 | 不适用 | 不适用 | 需 scan_publish_en 同时为 True；话题为 cloud_registered_body，坐标系为 body |
| `tf_send_en` | `False` | 不适用，布尔 | **通常保持当前值，不作为优先调试项** | 是否由 Point-LIO 发布自身位姿 TF | 不适用 | 不适用 | 当前集成链保持 False；True 发布 camera_init → aft_mapped，数值对应内部 IMU 位姿；独立调试开启时需核对 TF 组织，不是底盘位姿 TF |
9441169c7ca5b6b95c0e47973f605cb85c0f7400.translatedText:
| Parameter name | Current value | Unit | Vehicle processing suggestion | Function | Effect of increasing | Effect of decreasing | Effective conditions / notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path_en` | `False` | Not applicable, Boolean | **Enable or set according to actual functional requirements** | Whether to publish the accumulated runtime trajectory | Not applicable | Not applicable | When True, publish path, with coordinate frame camera_init; trajectory continuously accumulates |
| `scan_publish_en` | `True` | Not applicable, Boolean | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority debugging item** | Whether to publish the registered scan point cloud in the reference frame | Not applicable | Not applicable | Publish cloud_registered, with coordinate frame camera_init; local PCD point cloud accumulation also depends on this switch |
| `scan_bodyframe_pub_en` | `False` | Not applicable, Boolean | **Enable or set according to actual functional requirements** | Whether to additionally publish the point cloud in the internal IMU coordinate frame | Not applicable | Not applicable | Requires scan_publish_en to also be True; the topic is cloud_registered_body, and the coordinate frame is body |
| `tf_send_en` | `False` | Not applicable, Boolean | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority debugging item** | Whether Point-LIO publishes its own pose TF | Not applicable | Not applicable | The current integration chain keeps False; True publishes camera_init → aft_mapped, and the values correspond to the internal IMU pose; when enabled for standalone debugging, the TF organization must be checked, and it is not the chassis pose TF |
